description: Review a proposed shared-stream CUDA graph callback contract with an updated device block containing current state, direction, output pointers, time and gamma. Identify stale-buffer or error-propagation falsifiers; do not accept numerical results.

Derive a general block-preconditioner setup/apply algorithm from model equations and dependencies, keeping full residual and Jacobian-vector products. Compare architectural hypotheses under a bounded compute budget.

Compile and execute matched long-duration neuronal simulation benchmarks with frozen equations, error criteria, resource measurements, and transaction/preconditioner regression tests; preserve failures and publish actual evidence.
